name: Do I need a handrail on both sides of my staircase?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a handrail on both sides of my staircase?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building codes typically require a handrail on at least one side of a staircase with three or more risers. However, for wider staircases or those with specific safety concerns, installing handrails on both sides is often recommended. This provides additional support and accessibility, especially beneficial for families with children, elderly individuals, or those with mobility challenges. While not always code-mandated for both sides, it significantly enhances safety and user convenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building codes usually require one handrail for stairs with three or more risers, but installing handrails on both sides is recommended for wider stairs or enhanced safety.
